in_sanskrit.name: Greeshi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wise Protector
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Greeshi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Greeshi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Grih' which means 'house' and 'Ish' which means 'protector'. This name is given to a child who is believed to be the guardian of his family and possessions.
